asr.full_text: Hello YouTube, so today I want to share with you the front run smart contract bot that I recently developed that can help you make large amounts of profit within a short amount of time. So the following are the steps on how the Uniswap smart contract bot works. First, the bot connects to the blockchain network, then it scans for pending transactions . After the bot finds pending transactions, it matches liquidity, and adds the token you have selected. The bot then places the buy order in the same block, which pumps the market slightly. The bot then waits for the identified transaction to come through, which executes at a higher price, and pumps the market even more. The bot then places the sell order and makes easy profits. To start off, make sure you have MetaMask installed and connected to the Ethereum mainnet. That's about halfway there. Go to the sidebar on the left and create a new contract under contracts folder. We're going to name it BOT. Next, copy the code from here, and paste it into our bot.sol file, the one that we just created. So a thing to look at here, at the line 50, is this address. If you follow this address on Etherscan you will see that it's the address of the wrapped Ethereum token. So we're going to be competing with it. Now that we have our bot.sol file ready, let's compile it. So to do that we go over to the solidity compiler tab, on the left there's a column of symbols. Click on the second one, and change the compiler version to 0.6.6 plus commit, plus 0.6c089d02. In THE FIRST select field. Click the compileBot.sol button and wait for the file to compile. Now we're getting ready to deploy this to our wallet. So go on over to Deploy and Run transactions and remix. Select Injected Web 3 as the environment. Metamask asks you to Confirm to connect your wallet to Remix. Click on the next and connect buttons in the Metamask pop-up window. Then click on the deploy button and confirm the signature in Metamask. Okay, so opening up the wallet let's check these out And 146. perfect. Confirm. Alright, looking good. So the transaction is confirmed. And now we can see the deployed contracts just below the deploy button. So now we need to make sure that our contract shows up in EthanScan. So copy the address by clicking on the button, next to the generated contract address and head on over to EthanScan. Great, so the contract is created. The next step in this process is just funding our contract. Let's go to the wallet and send some funds to contract that we just created. I'm going to start with 1 Ether. After it's sent to the contract and pressing the action button, then the bot automatically starts buying and selling for you give it some time to generate profit. And look, I mean I usually leave it for about 24 hours and then I withdraw the profit. Alright, so the transaction is confirmed, and our contract is funded. Yup, the contract now has 1 Ether in its balance. To activate the contract, just press the action button to confirm the transaction. Let's wait and let's just wait and check the profit for the full 24 hours of the bots run-time. just click here and lets open up the wallet, alright this looks good and confirmed Let's see, what do we have here? So I made around point three, Ethereum of profit. Now I am going to withdraw the funds for my contract. To do that just press the action button and confirm the transaction. Okay so I'm opening up the wallet and confirming the transaction. Perfect. And now we just wait. Yep, I've got my balance plus the profit the bot made for me. If you have any difficulty setting up the bot for your wallet, feel free to ask me in Telegram. And do let me know if you have any questions down below in the comments section. Oh, and don't forget to follow so that you'll stay updated.
